candidates.novelty: new concrete mechanism-discrimination episode; specialization of existing bounded-regression knowledge, not a new kernel rule
candidates.applicability: Observable stateful operations, parsers, caches, transactions, concurrent services; useful when multiple explanations fit current observations.
candidates.minimal_change: Retrieval-scoped strategy note: when a repair explanation remains ambiguous, compare competing models on a small input where their predictions differ; retain old controls and test a fresh interaction distribution. No required number of hypotheses/cases.
candidates.validation_design: Replay retained htmlq historical checkpoint and four model variants on original controls and 35 discriminators; independently generate new combinations before examining outcome. Separately test strategy prompt on fresh stateful tasks with equal allocations and blinded scoring.
candidates.confidence_boundaries: High confidence that recorded outputs distinguish the tested models; no replay here and no proof of actual upstream internal ownership implementation or external-score contribution. Hand-tuned models may still overfit.
candidates.score_effect: No causal score-gain estimate. Official scores retained independently of internal Support.
candidates.title: Distinguish competing explanations with new inputs
candidates.mechanism: Several htmlq cursor models fit the same207 failures and76 controls. A new35-case ownership discriminator separated their predictions. Retain earlier controls while seeking observations that distinguish the remaining explanations.

candidates.novelty: new observed cross-generation bottleneck, not merely repeat more tests
candidates.applicability: Compatibility/import tasks with artifacts from multiple producers or format generations; networked long-horizon tasks can obtain authorized historic specimens and compatibility docs.
candidates.minimal_change: Scoped strategy guidance: track which versions/producers/dependency conditions each successful end-to-end path covers. If many failures stop at the same early operation, investigate that boundary before unrelated leaf symptoms. Do not hardcode old-format priority globally.
candidates.validation_design: Artifact-only paired reference/candidate controls on lawful v129/v138 inputs; then independent candidate variant with generalized format parsing and fresh per-version downstream probes. Keep original artifact/results immutable.
candidates.confidence_boundaries: 326 is a text-marker count among965 nonpassing tests, not326 recoverable passes. No independent replay; supporting the header may expose missing semantics. Source ./src/tpr.py:51-52 and official /test_results/2 establish narrow rejection, not all low-score causes.
candidates.score_effect: No causal score-gain estimate. Official scores retained independently of internal Support.
candidates.title: Find shared entry points and uncovered format generations
candidates.mechanism: Gromacs accepted generated v138 inputs but rejected v129 inputs at a shared loader boundary. Group failures by the first shared divergence and characterize supported producer/version conditions before extending downstream features.

candidates.novelty: new boundary evidence and strong counterexample to local-count-as-quality; core observation rule already absorbed
candidates.applicability: Tools with compiler/runtime/database/service dependencies; ordinary connected tasks may provision approved dependencies, benchmark attempts cannot retroactively change grants or hidden fixtures.
candidates.minimal_change: Retain a capability-conditioned observation matrix in knowledge; diagnose through a successful minimal transaction where authorized. Harness need only expose actual environment and process results; strategy chooses provisioning/checks.
candidates.validation_design: Fresh paired runs under dependency absent/present while holding source and invocation fixed; compare reference and candidate stage of failure and output files. For Revive first capture actual evaluator stderr/PATH and go list std before asserting a cause.
candidates.confidence_boundaries: Tinycc candidate source genuinely checks filesystem, not merely hardcoded failure; provisioning may help but compiler defects remain. Revive official excerpts lack enough stderr to attribute all410 failures. No assertion that grading repair alone restores their scores.
candidates.score_effect: No causal score-gain estimate. Official scores retained independently of internal Support.
candidates.title: Preserve the conditions under which behavior was observed
candidates.mechanism: Missing runtime, compiler or standard-library capabilities change which behavior a probe reaches. Record successful-path conditions and test materially different deployment conditions instead of learning an initialization failure as the complete behavior.

candidates.novelty: new controlled-substitution and negative-transfer evidence, reinforcing existing preservation mechanism
candidates.applicability: Pipelines: train/load/predict, parse/plan/execute, produce/serialize/read, API/cache/storage. Works without global deadline; expected usefulness guides choice, actual limits bound execution.
candidates.minimal_change: Keep as retrieval-scoped mechanism knowledge: use controlled intermediate artifacts to isolate a suspect stage, preserve passing cases that distinguish collateral damage, and retain an unresolved mismatch when proposed fixes regress better-supported behavior.
candidates.validation_design: Rerun synthetic inference with identical model bytes across candidate versions; paired ordinary/partial-pretrained controls; separate deterministic from allocator-sensitive cases. Fresh-task experiment measures regression rate and verified useful progress, not just number of probes.
candidates.confidence_boundaries: Observed artifact score311/312; remaining official failure is empty-vocabulary diagnostic, not automatically the historical allocation counterexample. Memory-layout imitation is benchmark compatibility work, not advice to introduce undefined behavior in production.
candidates.score_effect: No causal score-gain estimate. Official scores retained independently of internal Support.
candidates.title: Use controlled intermediate artifacts and preserve regression evidence
candidates.mechanism: FastText isolated training, inference and quantization with controlled model artifacts. A change that improved aggregate matches also broke a previously passing case; retain that counterexample when choosing the next revision.

candidates.novelty: new transaction/reopen/interrupt chains; general progress/cancellation distinction already specified
candidates.applicability: Long-running training, migrations, services, financial/workflow tools; cancellation semantics depend on user contract.
candidates.minimal_change: Scoped strategy asks what must survive error/reopen/cancel and verifies those observable postconditions. Essential harness can expose cancellation acknowledgment, process liveness and retained artifact identities, without deciding that every task needs graceful best-model saving.
candidates.validation_design: Fault injection before first artifact, after checkpoint and during replacement; verify original artifact identity, final liveness and user-required output. For transactions, distinguish parse/bind/runtime errors and inspect both current and reopened state.
candidates.confidence_boundaries: Duckdb remains48.11%, so these successful repairs do not establish whole-engine equivalence. fasttext SIGINT is domain behavior, not evidence ProContract kernel needs a new transition. Cancellation never implies completion automatically.
candidates.score_effect: No causal score-gain estimate. Official scores retained independently of internal Support.
candidates.title: Check state transitions and artifacts after cancellation
candidates.mechanism: DuckDB constraints changed across reopen, while FastText cancellation had observable output-model semantics. Check the user-visible transition, retained artifact and process shutdown separately; no universal checkpoint-on-cancel rule follows.

candidates.novelty: reinforcement with new cases, not a newly discovered rule
candidates.applicability: Nondeterministic services, timestamps, addresses, concurrency, locale; stable business effects still need verification.
candidates.minimal_change: Retain variability specification with repeated observations and raw output; normalize only fields whose variation was observed and irrelevant to stated obligation. No scorer modifications.
candidates.validation_design: Counter-control changes stable text/order/side effect and must still fail the comparator; repeated identical launches estimate variability at the recorded condition. Never transfer a normalizer from local tests into pinned official scorer.
candidates.confidence_boundaries: rnr and go-mod-outdated are official full scores; not proof their local normalizers caused success. ethabi sole official failure involves duplicate param type; no rerun establishes it is the same varying-error family.
candidates.score_effect: No causal score-gain estimate. Official scores retained independently of internal Support.
candidates.title: Normalize only observed variation within the relevant obligation
candidates.mechanism: rnr, go-mod-outdated and ethabi exposed variable ordering or addresses alongside stable behavior. Preserve raw observations and negative controls so normalization cannot conceal changed stable output or side effects.

candidates.novelty: prior mechanism plus parent-reported concrete recovery cases; this study does not requalify the ongoing fixes
candidates.applicability: Durable operations and artifact-only measurement, including tasks without global deadlines.
candidates.minimal_change: Essential mechanism only: retain operation/stage identity, immutable source hash, liveness/closure receipt and original allocation; expose lossless supported artifact capture and precise unsupported-member error. Strategy decides remeasurement/repair; no automatic grading retries or work heuristics in kernel.
candidates.validation_design: Parent owns Felix/FIFO/Oha controls. Qualify closed-vs-active-vs-unknown writers, long relative names, FIFO metadata without reads, and interrupted extraction/recovery idempotency; measure same archive independently, never overwrite raw result.
candidates.confidence_boundaries: Parent-reported age first cause is helper build package collision before pytest; receipt absence is downstream. No score predicted for eight cases. No blanket relaxation for devices, escaping symlinks or unknown writers.
candidates.score_effect: No causal score-gain estimate. Official scores retained independently of internal Support.
candidates.title: Keep operation outcomes, current closure and artifact measurements distinct
candidates.mechanism: Publication errors, final writer closure, filesystem transport and official grading are separate observations. Implement reliable identity and lossless transport without turning an empirical workflow into a kernel invariant.

candidates.novelty: application design built on existing qualified RSI operations, not a claim of current campaign-wide subscription
candidates.applicability: Research responsibilities consuming terminal outcomes and later corrections, no mandatory finite deadline.
candidates.minimal_change: Prepare immutable evidence bundles and scoped knowledge proposals; register proposed context/code versions only within admitted scope. Strategy selects relevant investigations and protected experiments. Harness deduplicates transport and retains receipts; existing kernel governs authorized adoption.
candidates.validation_design: Replay same evidence ID after receipt loss (no duplicate action); correction after wait remains pending until selected handler sees it; stale-incumbent adoption rejected; trial with unseen tasks, actual version-bound execution and raw scores before any promotion.
candidates.confidence_boundaries: No RSI runtime was activated by this retrospective. Correlation in a selected reused benchmark cannot authorize automatic code deployment. Retrieval should bring applicable counterevidence, not append every lesson to all prompts.
candidates.score_effect: No causal score-gain estimate. Official scores retained independently of internal Support.
candidates.title: Receiving evidence does not itself select or promote a strategy
candidates.mechanism: Retain immutable source identities and late corrections in the existing RSI input/knowledge flow. The selected strategy interprets evidence and proposes scoped validation; evidence arrival alone does not authorize code promotion.

candidates.novelty: Specific false-equivalence failure and minimal observer-interface mechanism; general source/subject binding already exists.
candidates.applicability: Differential testing, A/B experiments, model/evaluator selection, old/new API or database comparisons; when wrappers/defaults can substitute targets.
candidates.minimal_change: Scoped strategy knowledge: qualify actual target propagation and, when consequential, use a known-distinct control. Tool candidate: require target explicitly and capture resolved identity, without installing a mandatory global test workflow.
candidates.validation_design: Replay omitted-argument probe against a deliberately different executable; old probe should falsely match and corrected probe distinguish. Include path aliases, two valid identical-content builds, stale capture reuse and target identity changing between selection/execution. Separately test on fresh tasks before broad adoption.
candidates.confidence_boundaries: Direct historical call/patch/output evidence; no fresh probe rerun here. Solver-authored tool bug, not evidence of a global ProContract implementation defect. Same hash can be legitimate. No attribution of82 improved tests to this fix.
candidates.score_effect: No isolated estimate; jplot original Luna479/583, original Sol557/583;82 improve and4 regress on matched IDs.
candidates.title: Bind differential probes to the actual execution targets
candidates.mechanism: Two jplot probes labeled outputs ref/new while invoking the reference twice because an executable argument was omitted. Make target selection explicit and retain actual target identities; a deliberately different control can test comparator detection capability.
